summary.result: Four non-member farmers have constructed a septic tanks and several member farmers have constructed the fermentation system of sawdust and hulls.
summary.background: In the monthly meetings, the active discussion about agricultural environmental pollution gradually increased with the village people, Club members and other people because of a consciousness-raising created through discussion activities.
summary.method: After two years, the number of septic tanks and accumulation store-houses has increased from two to 10.
